Serverless bot wiring

  1. Deploy bot webhook: POST /bot<TOKEN> on your serverless host.
  2. Set webhook: setWebhook https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/setWebhook?url=https://<host>/bot<TOKEN>
  3. Validate Mini App initData with BOT_TOKEN (HMAC-SHA256).
  4. Reply with answerWebAppQuery or sendMessage with web_app button.
POST /bot$TOKEN  -> verify initData
-> { "method": "sendMessage",
     "chat_id": 123,
     "text": "Opened from Mini App!" }

BotFather checklist

/newbot → save BOT_TOKEN as serverless secret. /newapp → point Web App URL to this deployment. /setmenubutton → link Mini App to chat menu.
